D4_fault_model: one or two undirected edges, each carrying one of the seven nonidentity D4 permutations with inverse reverse direction
bianchi_localization: the complete triangle syndrome is injective for no fault plus all one- and two-edge nonidentity D4 faults
claim_boundary: Exact permutation/gauge fault model. Coherent partial faults, loss, and detector erasure require the optical channel model.
lower_bound_proof: Each measured triangle covers exactly three of 45 edges. Forty-five distinct nonzero binary edge signatures have total Hamming weight at least m+2(45-m)=90-m, while total incidence is 3m; hence m>=23.
two_edge_schedule_optimality: open; 29 is a verified construction, not a minimum claim
